cache: query caches disabled; warm FSDirectory readers; no transport or production admission

memory.allocated: ThreadMXBean thread allocation delta over preparation plus search
memory.retained: Lucene RamUsageTester graph size of prepared membership query; excludes readers
memory.peak_membership: owned membership structures during preparation; hash+current seen set sampled at leaf boundaries/every 4096 documents, or sum of foreign/local ordinal bitmaps; excludes iterators, reallocation overlap, and query rewrite; not JVM heap high-water mark
